title: Playing with Charlie McCurdy's band
summary: Shortly before McCurdy's death he played clarinet and soprano in a band with violin, trumpet, alto, Helen Edwards on piano and a drummer.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: I took music lessons with Papa T.O. I was still going and taking music lessons. I was looking for improvement all the time. Greater improvement. Well, then I was out playing. I even had time enough to play with Charlie McCoyty.

Yeah. Yeah. Just a couple of years before he died. I got to playing. Charlie McCoyty was playing a band. I was playing with a band. Ronald McNeil was playing violin. Martin was playing trumpet. Charlie McCoyty was playing alto and clarinet. I was playing clarinet and soprano. Piano player, Helen Edwards was playing piano. This boy, that's how you call him again, drummer. Chris. A little bit of short fellow, Chris. He was on drums.
About what year was that? Do you remember?
